Search the 'Discogs' database

Source: R/search.R
dig_search.Rd

Searches the releases, master releases, artists and labels in the 'Discogs' database. Search needs a token, see dig_auth(), but the token can belong to any user.

Usage

dig_search(
  query = NULL,
  type = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  release_title = NULL,
  credit = NULL,
  artist = NULL,
  anv = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  genre = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  country = NULL,
  year = NULL,
  format = NULL,
  catno = NULL,
  barcode = NULL,
  track = NULL,
  sort = c("score", "title", "have", "want", "hot", "date_added", "date_changed", "year"),
  order = c("desc", "asc"),
  all = FALSE,
  page = 1,
  per_page = 50
)

Arguments

query

The search query, or NULL to search with filters only.

type

The type of result: "release", "master", "artist" or "label", or NULL for all types.

title

The combined title, as in "Juniper Static - Lantern Weather".

release_title

The title of the release.

credit

A name in the credits.

artist

The name of the artist.

anv

The name the artist is credited as on the release.

label, genre, style, country, year, format, catno, barcode

Values to filter the results by, for example format = "Vinyl" or year = 1994.

track

The title of a track.

sort

The column to sort by: "score", the relevance to the query, "title", "have", "want", "hot", "date_added", "date_changed" or "year".

order

The sort order: "asc" or "desc".

all

If TRUE, all pages are fetched and page and per_page are ignored.

page

The page to fetch.

per_page

The number of items per page, from 1 to 100.

Value

A tibble with one row per result, or NULL invisibly if the API cannot be reached. type tells releases, master releases, artists and labels apart, and id is the ID of either. title combines the artist and the title, and for artists and labels it is the name. genres and styles are list columns. have and want are the numbers of users with the item in their collection or wantlist. Columns that do not apply to a type, such as catno for artists, are NA.

Details

Give a search query, one or more filters, or both. Each filter searches one field, so artist = "Juniper Static" finds releases by that artist but not releases that only mention the name in their title. The IDs in id can be passed to dig_release(), dig_master(), dig_artist() or dig_label(), depending on type.

'Discogs' returns up to 100 results per page. With all = TRUE, every page is fetched, which takes one request for each 100 results.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
dig_search("Lantern Weather", type = "release")
dig_search(artist = "Juniper Static", format = "Vinyl", year = 1994)
}
